main: Inflicts more {st:Combustion} based on {st:Charge} Potency on self. Also generates and consumes a lot of {st:Charge} Count.
Increases the target's damage taken from {keyword:Wrath} and {keyword:Envy} skills for the current and next turn.
Passive gives him consistent {st:Binding} application in a Reson team and bonus damage when using {st:Combustion} or {st:Charge} skills at 3+ {st:Charge} Potency.

- Base Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency or Count on the enemy
